answer: Each identity relays its pulse along a spiral of beacons, and every beacon stamps the moment the pulse passes. At settlement, the spiral ledger compares the stamp trails: two pulses that crossed the same beacons in step belong to one operator — both lose their 400,000 POA bonds, their rewards pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. Five fakes therefore cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
